## Summary

I implemented support for the custom block-level tags `<signature>` and `<stamp>` in the Markdown conversion pipeline, entirely within the source file `docling/backend/md_backend.py` (no test files touched).

### How marko parses these tags
- Single-line form (`<signature>TEXT</signature>`) → a `Paragraph` containing `InlineHTML` open/close tags around a `RawText`.
- Multi-line form → a `HTMLBlock`.

I handle both forms.

### Changes to `docling/backend/md_backend.py`

1. **Imports** — added `PictureItem`, `PictureMeta`, `PictureClassificationMetaField`, `PictureClassificationPrediction` from `docling_core.types.doc`.

2. **Regexes** — module-level patterns matching the open tag, close tag, and a whole-block form (multi-line, `DOTALL`) for the two classes `signature` and `stamp`.

3. **`_get_custom_tag_block`** — detects when a paragraph is a pure custom tag (first/last children are matching inline-HTML open/close tags) and extracts `(class_name, inner_text)`, recursively collecting the inner text.

4. **`_create_custom_tag_picture`** — creates a picture via `add_picture`, sets `meta.classification.predictions[0].class_name` to `signature`/`stamp`, and, when present, attaches the inner text as a text child (with both `text` and `orig` set).

5. **Hooks** — one at the top of `_iterate_elements` (single-line/inline form, returns early to avoid the generic inline-group/text path), and one in the `HTMLBlock` branch (multi-line form, decrementing `_html_blocks` so the HTML-delegation path isn't triggered).

### Verified behavior
Interleaved with regular text, the input:
```

<stamp>Stamp</stamp>
```
exports to markdown as `Signature\n\n<!-- image -->` and `Stamp\n\n<!-- image -->`, with document ordering preserved, pictures classified correctly, and inner text stored as text children.
